caption: The drawing depicts a single necklace arranged in a loose coil on a vertically oriented piece of paper. The necklace is primarily composed of a grayish cord, which is detailed with several colorful beads spaced irregularly along its length. The beads are small and round, shown in red, blue, purple, and turquoise hues. There are also two larger, teardrop-shaped beads near the upper center, colored in a gradient of light blue to teal. At the bottom of the necklace hangs a large, faceted, elongated pendant, shaded in gray pencil. The background is a plain, light beige, and the drawing itself is centered within a rectangular inset on a slightly larger, similarly colored sheet, with some yellowing visible at the edges.
title: Necklace
